events.label: OpenAI IPOs above $1T
events.title: When will OpenAI IPO?
events.subtitle: Before Jan 1, 2027
events.rules: If OpenAI confirms an IPO before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.label: US enacts AI safety bill
events.title: Will independent AI safety audits become U.S. law before Jan 1, 2027?
events.subtitle: Before Jan 1, 2027
events.rules: If federal legislation requiring independent AI safety evaluations or audits has become law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.label: No Fed rate cuts in 2026
events.title: Will the Fed cut rates 0 times?
events.subtitle: Exactly 0 cuts
events.rules: If the Fed cuts 0 times starting Jan 1, 2026 and before 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.label: US recession by end of 2026
events.title: Will there be a recession in 2026?
events.subtitle: Starts
events.rules: If there are two consecutive quarters of negative GDP growth in 2025 or 2026, according to the Bureau of Economic Analysis, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.label: Strait of Hormuz traffic normalizes
events.title: Will the 7-day moving average of transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz as reported by the IMF PortWatch be above 60 before January 1, 2027?
events.subtitle: Before Jan 1, 2027
events.rules: If the 7-day moving average of transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz as reported by the IMF PortWatch is above 60 before January 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.label: US-Iran final nuclear deal
events.title: Will the US agree to a new Iranian nuclear deal this year?
events.subtitle: Before Jan 1, 2027
events.rules: If the United States has agreed to, signed, or accepted a new Iran-US nuclear deal before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.label: Bitcoin reaches $100k in 2026
events.title: Will Bitcoin be above $100000.00 by Jan 1, 2027 at 12:00AM ET?
events.subtitle: Before January 2027
events.rules: If the Bitcoin spot price according to the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index is above $100000.00 starting 02/17/2026 04:00 PM and before Jan 1, 2027 at 12:00AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
